name: How should I prepare my bathroom before low threshold shower installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my bathroom before low threshold shower installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contractors arrive, clear out personal toiletries, remove hanging accessories, and establish an open path from the home entryway to the bathroom. You should also decide on your preferred fixtures, tile materials, and accessory locations beforehand. If you have mobility needs, note the ideal heights for grab bars and shower controls so framing blocking can be placed accurately. Knowing where your main water shutoff valve is located also helps ensure a smooth start on demolition day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal items, clear a path for the crew, decide on tile and fixture styles, and determine preferred heights for grab bars and controls.
